def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    measurements = [-3, -11, 3, -18, 18, 20, -6, 9, 2, -16]
    sample_size = len(measurements)

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    mean = sum(measurements) / sample_size
    sample_variance = sum(
        (value - mean) ** 2 for value in measurements
    ) / (sample_size - 1)
    sample_standard_deviation = sample_variance ** 0.5
    answer = round(sample_standard_deviation, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
